info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Communications API
Return the data for all Communications

params.name: contact_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Contact. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the Communication records with the matching property.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter Communication records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: date
params.description: Filter Communication records to those that occur on the specified date (Expects an ISO-8601 date).

params.name: external_property_name
params.description:
Filter records to only those with the given external property(s) name set.

e.g. `?external_property_name=Name`

params.name: external_property_value
params.description:
Filter records to only those with the given external property(s) value set. Requires external property name as well.

e.g. `?external_property_name=Name&external_property_value=Value`

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: having_time_entries
params.description: Filter Communication records to those that do or do not have time entries.

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter Communication records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of Communication records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Matter. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Communication. The list will be filtered to include only the Communication records with the matching property.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the Communication records by the given field. Default: `date(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: query
params.description: Wildcard search for `body` or `subject` matching a given string.

params.name: received_at
params.description: Filter Communication records to those that occur on the specified date (Expects an ISO-8601 date-time).

params.name: received_before
params.description: Filter Communication records to those whose `date` is on or before the date provided (Expects an ISO-8601 date).

params.name: received_since
params.description: Filter Communication records to those whose `date` is on or after the date provided (Expects an ISO-8601 date).

params.name: type
params.description: Filter Communication records to those of the specified type.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter Communication records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: user_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single User. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the Communication records with the matching property.
